answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the orchard. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
